limitations: A surviving trial is not necessarily command tracking; low lateral commands can remain standing.
1/2ms extra sample age, 5ms torque lag and modeled1kHz internal PD are sensitivity assumptions, not identified actuator dynamics.
Recorded software/realtime to monotonic conversion is estimated; input timing trace is not a measured torque response.
Linear calibrated differential only; nonlinear linkage and powered actuator timing not identified.
The supported fixture is six-axis and stronger than a rope. All tested preposition-to-release candidates tripped before unassisted evaluation.
No candidate controller, gain ramp or motor enable was activated on hardware.
